definition: In scope: countries whose law entitles all residents to health coverage, whatever the financing model. Each profile also reports effective coverage (UHC service coverage index, out-of-pocket share, catastrophic spending) so the gap between promise and delivery is visible.

baseline.name: United States
baseline.note: Comparison baseline; does not meet the definition. Gets a full profile (wave 0) with extra coverage-gap and insurer-decision evidence.

countries.name: United States
countries.why: Comparison baseline: uninsured and underinsured, medical debt, insurer decisions on care

countries.name: Germany
countries.why: Social health insurance, oldest Bismarck system

countries.name: Japan
countries.why: Mixed social insurance, long life expectancy, ageing population

countries.name: Mexico
countries.why: System in the middle of repeated reforms

countries.name: Taiwan
countries.note: Not covered by World Bank or WHO statistics; indicators come from Taiwan's own official sources.
